confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain. July is rainy and shoulder season in Puerto Vallarta, so accommodation anchors reflect off-peak rates, not the December-April high season. Cocktail and wine anchors are based on the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. Taxes are assumed to be included in accommodation figures. FX is the latest RBA observation returned by web search summary; the F11 table itself was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mexican Pacific resort-city pricing, benchmarked against other Mexican beach destinations with similar tourism mix, priced at the Puerto Vallarta level and adjusted for July off-peak and rainy-season demand.
